keyEvents.text: Goal! Crewe Alexandra 1, AFC Wimbledon 0. Charlie McNeill (Crewe Alexandra) right footed shot from more than 35 yards to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Conor Thomas.
Jordan Gibson (Crewe Alexandra) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alistair Smith (AFC Wimbledon) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Crewe Alexandra 2, AFC Wimbledon 0. Conor Thomas (Crewe Alexandra) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Aron Sasu (AFC Wimbledon) Substitution at 66'
Callum Maycock (AFC Wimbledon) Substitution at 66'
Zack Nelson (AFC Wimbledon) Substitution at 67'
Reece Hutchinson (Crewe Alexandra) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Adrien Thibaut (Crewe Alexandra) Substitution at 71'
Owen Lunt (Crewe Alexandra) Substitution at 71'
Calum Agius (Crewe Alexandra) Substitution at 76'
Joel Tabiner (Crewe Alexandra) Substitution at 76'
Joe White (Crewe Alexandra) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Andy Yiadom (AFC Wimbledon) Substitution at 79'
Donnell Mcneilly (AFC Wimbledon) Substitution at 79'
Goal! Crewe Alexandra 2, AFC Wimbledon 1. Andy Yiadom (AFC Wimbledon) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Donnell McNeilly.
Callum Maycock (AFC Wimbledon) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
James Tilley (AFC Wimbledon) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Adrien Thibaut (Crewe Alexandra) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Lewis Billington (Crewe Alexandra) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Kyle Ure (Crewe Alexandra) Substitution at 90'+3'
